purpose: Define a non-Lepidoptera Palearctic terrestrial-holometabolous secondary analysis asking whether similarity in LGM climatic refugial opportunity predicts concordance of post-IBD spatial genetic structure.

chronology_and_claim_boundary.reason_for_supersession: Separate this study from the butterfly ecology paper and prevent a 26/44 Lepidoptera-dominated panel. This scope change was made before any LGM relation, TTF-Q result, or subgroup genetic response.
chronology_and_claim_boundary.interpretation: Prospectively frozen secondary ecological reanalysis within an already-opened archive; not an untouched confirmatory dataset.

allowed_pre_response_surfaces: occurrence coordinates linked to selected COI headers
forbidden_before_opening: pair-specific T_st for the new v0.2 panel
beta_LGM or any subgroup genetic coefficient

taxon.developmental_scope: Holometabola excluding Lepidoptera, with a conservative terrestrial family filter.
taxon.rationale: Avoid a second butterfly-dominated paper while retaining a coherent fully metamorphic terrestrial insect domain; ambiguous aquatic or semiaquatic Diptera are excluded rather than adjudicated after ecological results.

palearctic.locality_surface: exact unique coordinates linked to the selected COI-family aligned FASTA headers
palearctic.rule: Clip the new genetic subgeometry to Palearctic localities and require at least 12 Palearctic localities per species.
palearctic.rationale: The question concerns evaluable genetic geography within the Palearctic, not whether the species is Palearctic-endemic; Holarctic species may enter if the Palearctic subgeometry itself is sufficient.

dyad_geometry.source_target_roles: Every retained species appears as both a source and a target; self-dyads are excluded.
dyad_geometry.dependence: Two-way source/target dependence is retained and explicitly qualified by TTF-Q.

lgm_climatic_suitability_model.common_space: pooled current occurrence climate, z-standardized, canonical-sign PCA, all four whitened PCs
lgm_climatic_suitability_model.primary_relation: Schoener D between normalized LGM suitability surfaces
lgm_climatic_suitability_model.nuisance_current_relation: Schoener D between normalized current suitability surfaces

empirical_question_if_opening_is_authori.response: Directed pairwise post-IBD transfer T_st under the already frozen genetic transfer operator, recomputed only for the v0.2 Palearctic-clipped subgeometry.
empirical_question_if_opening_is_authori.model: T_st = source_FE + target_FE + beta_LGM*z_R_LGM + declared controls + error
empirical_question_if_opening_is_authori.biological_hypothesis: Non-Lepidoptera Palearctic terrestrial insects with more similar LGM climatic refugial opportunity should share more reusable geography of post-IBD genetic differentiation.
